tasks.title: 电竞鼠标：完成TA发现意图与体验判断稿

criteria.criterion: AM Infinity Mouse家族与原版/.97分开，提供实握、游戏及配置证据字段
criteria.detail: 06-mouse-discovery-draft.md separates the family, original-model URL and .97 URL; its evidence-card section specifies exact model/version/market, firmware/software, connection/settings, hand dimensions/grip, game/environment and author disclosures. It does not claim these fields have actual measurements.

criteria.criterion: 交付中英电竞鼠标实际内容和三类TA探索问题，明确需要、阶段与渠道
criteria.detail: 06 supplies ZH/EN substantive copy for A gaming fit, B form/material experience and C model/battery understanding, with needs/stages/channels; 02 supplies all A/B/C bilingual exploratory questions with explicit need, journey stage and channel.

criteria.criterion: 不选择37g/39g，不编造性能/搜索量/分数，固定48题及面板不改
criteria.detail: 06 explicitly quarantines 37g/39g and omits performance/runtime/pricing numbers; 02 records unrun status, null metrics and semantic-overlap handling. Both recorded fixed baseline SHA256 values match current files; no baseline replacement is implied.

tasks.title: AI device：完成R6命名与能力边界卡

criteria.criterion: 基于官方预热资料记录CYBERBOARD AI/R6同页命名线索，不认定所有版本等同
criteria.detail: 05-ai-device-clarity.md records CYBERBOARD AI body naming and R6 alt-text as same-page naming evidence only; explicitly rejects treating arbitrary R6 files, old CYBERBOARD manuals and the teaser as equivalent editions.

criteria.criterion: 提供A/B/C中英问答、需要、阶段与渠道，品牌功能声明与独立验证分开
criteria.detail: 05 contains A/B/C questions and answers in ZH/EN plus stages, channels and evidence requirements. Voice transcription and supported-device hardware control are attributed to the brand teaser, followed by explicit not_tested/final-version limits rather than asserted independent success.

criteria.criterion: 隔离预量产规格、发货占位符与未知AI范围，不推断离线/隐私/准确率
criteria.detail: 05 excludes price/benefit/date/shipping/final-compatibility promises and lists unknown offline, cloud/model, privacy/data-retention, languages, permissions, reversibility, latency/accuracy and OS/app scope. 01 and web-evidence preserve preproduction/placeholder and differing retrieval context.

tasks.title: 双主线：更新AM品牌与三类TA的中英表达

criteria.criterion: 用户电竞鼠标+AI device定位覆盖旧refs键盘核心，并明确继承与冲突
criteria.detail: 01-brand-gap.md prioritizes the 2026-11-01 explicit user direction: AM Infinity Mouse esports mouse plus AI device represented by CYBERBOARD R6. It lists legacy keyboard-core and R4-latest as superseded context, while retaining Future Art Community, original design, community participation and candor. config/brand-context.json and config/project.json agree.

criteria.criterion: 交付品牌核心与A/B/C三类TA的中英具体稿，兼顾双主线
criteria.detail: 03-brand-message-draft.md provides actual ZH/EN brand text and A/B/C text/headlines across both product lines, with journey/channel and evidence slots. It does not reduce the new direction to a keyboard marketing plan.

criteria.criterion: 品牌定位不作为人口统计或性能证明，不包含无依据价格/发货/稀缺/联名承诺
criteria.detail: 01/03 explicitly treat the TA and positioning as planning inputs rather than demographics or hardware validation; no current price, delivery, scarcity, licensing or performance assurance is made. Disputed numerical claims appear only as exclusions.

tasks.title: 双主线：完成社区/创作者证据与参与brief

criteria.criterion: 中英站外渠道和实际核读范围分开，检索可读与正文壳分别标注
criteria.detail: 04-community-evidence-map.md separates Chinese ZFrontier/Bilibili/WeChat roles from English Discord/Reddit/X/video-review roles. Novel and AM Master are labelled search-readable/direct-body-shell; the teaser is body-readable/brand-claim/preproduction. It does not claim current channel activity or complete coverage.

criteria.criterion: 提供双主线中英创作者brief及证据卡验收规则，不伪造UGC或认可
criteria.detail: 04 provides ZH/EN creator briefs for both mouse control and AI-device workflow/material evidence plus model/version/market, conditions, source dates, disclosure, limitations and material-rights fields. It asks creators to retain their own judgment rather than writing fabricated testimonials.

criteria.criterion: 不连接私域/发送消息/复用未授权素材，当前参与和购买条件保持待核实
criteria.detail: 04 states no private-group access, messages, downloads or UGC reuse and leaves current invitation, author permission, participation and purchase terms unverified. It is a local map/template, not evidence of an outreach campaign or published UGC.

The original-mouse source supports a separate model entry only, according to the recorded main-agent read. No original-model numbers, commerce status or performance have been certified.
No hardware, actual AI-device execution, private channels, production source/CMS write, publication or consumer-AI measurement was performed.
A local preparation task can pass these acceptance conditions while downstream publication, outreach and empirical evaluation remain unexecuted.
